verdict.rationale: Whether a cloud phone and contact-center SaaS publishes its source under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack mentions open-source code, a public repository, or a license. The evidence covers only the API, webhook tutorials and product features, which are not source availability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
